         AQUILEGIA VULGARIS

       Columbine

      (AQUILEGIA)


A remedy for hysteria. Globus and clavus hystericus. Women at climaxis,
      with vomiting of green substance, especially in the morning.   Sleeplessness  .
      Nervous trembling of body; sensitive to light and noise. Dysmenorrhœa of young girls.



Female.--  Menses scanty, with dull, painful, nightly increasing
      pressure in the right lumbar region.



Dose.--  First potency.
